skipped.reason: no Forge card has two instances of amplify, so separate working of several instances cannot occur in a Forge game; 702.38a-1 covers the single-instance behaviour

scenarios.title: A creature with amplify enters with counters for each shared-type card revealed from hand
decisions: A casts Daru Stinger, paying {3}{W} with the four Plains.
Both players pass; Daru Stinger starts to enter the battlefield.
As it enters, A reveals every Soldier card in hand (the amplify choice).

variants.label: one_soldier
variants.expected: A reveals Elite Vanguard. Daru Stinger enters with one +1/+1 counter, a 2/2. The revealed card stays in A's hand.

variants.label: no_soldier_in_hand
variants.delta: Elite Vanguard is in A's graveyard instead of A's hand, so A's hand holds no other Soldier.
variants.expected: No card can be revealed. Daru Stinger enters with no counters, a 1/1.

variants.label: two_soldiers
variants.delta: A's hand holds a second Elite Vanguard and A reveals both.
variants.expected: Daru Stinger enters with two +1/+1 counters, a 3/3.

scenarios.forge_notes: The reveal is a choice the harness fixes.
